title: Matthieu the Colossus - How to Beat (Gestral Arena)
description: How to find and beat Matthieu the Colossus in Expedition 33's Hidden Gestral Arena - attack patterns, parry timing and rewards.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Matthieu the Colossus is an optional boss fought in the Hidden Gestral Arena as part of the Arena tournament. He is a 1v1 duel - you fight him alone with a single character, so party synergy cannot bail you out.

sections.title: Where to Find Matthieu the Colossus
sections.content:
Location: Hidden Gestral Arena.

From the Gestral Arena checkpoint, head to the platform and speak to Limonsol to arrange the fight.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
Matthieu has no documented elemental weakness - and in the Arena format, elemental matching matters far less than it does elsewhere. You fight solo, so parry timing and raw single-target damage dominate.

Treat it as a physical matchup and bring your hardest-hitting single-target skills rather than an element-specific setup.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Defeating him is part of the Arena tournament chain in Gestral Village. The tournament is also how you eventually earn the Medalum weapon - and to get it, you must duel Sciel as Maelle.

sections.title: How to Beat Matthieu the Colossus
sections.content:
Matthieu is a fast puncher and the difficulty is reading his speed rather than surviving big hits.

He is left-handed - watch the left arm

His main attack is a left hook: he jumps in and swings his arm in an arc. Parry right as the blade starts moving toward you. Ignore feints with his right hand - they are not the real attack.

The uppercut uses the same timing

His other notable attack is an uppercut. The read is identical: watch the arm begin moving up toward you, and parry.

General approach

  • Keep your eyes on his left forearm and fist - that is where every real attack originates
  • Parry into counterattack rather than trading hits; his damage adds up fast
  • Because it is a solo duel, bring your most self-sufficient character rather than your best team player
